text:
**A** is better. Both responses exceed the 120-word limit, but A only slightly (roughly 130 words), while B is far over (roughly 190).

A is also more accurate and more concise. It keeps the 40-day figure, states the cash-out and shutdown rules correctly, and makes clear that the exempt warehouse staff are still covered by the cap and cash-out rules.

B opens with filler ("We would like to draw your attention…") and softens the mandatory cap to staff being "asked" to agree a plan. It also says the changes apply to "permanent staff", dropping the full-time/part-time detail. Its "Your action" line is awkwardly worded.

**A**
